::: {.digest-item}
**[Exploring Private 5G Networks Through the Lens of MNOs](https://www.gsma.com/about-us/regions/north-america/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/GSMA-North-America-Private-Networks.pdf)**

<span class="digest-source">GSMA OnGo Alliance</span>

<span class="lbl tldr">TLDR</span> An operator-side playbook for deploying Private 5G: requirements, the case for slicing, virtualization and edge computing, plus a step-by-step deployment guide. It frames Private 5G through MNO economics and operating models — how the operator captures value, and where the deployment pain points actually are.

<span class="lbl why">Why read it</span> A counterweight to vendor whitepapers. It matters when designing slice management, because the operator's operating model constrains what the management plane can assume.

<span class="digest-tags">#private-5g · #slicing · #mno</span>
:::

::: {.digest-item}
**[5G Core Operator Survey — 2025 Edition: Scaling 5G SA](https://www.mavenir.com/resources/white-paper-5g-core-operator-survey-2025-edition-scaling-5g-sa/)**

<span class="digest-source">Mavenir</span>

<span class="lbl tldr">TLDR</span> An operator survey on the services, infrastructure, and operating models driving the scaling of Standalone 5G core networks. Useful less for the conclusions than for the data: what operators are actually standardizing, where they are stuck, and which services justify the CAPEX.

<span class="lbl why">Why read it</span> A grounded view of what packet-core operators are actually shipping — a reality-check for the slice-management thesis.

<span class="digest-tags">#packet-core · #5g-sa · #operator</span>
:::

::: {.digest-item}
**[How AI-Powered Digital Twins Are Driving Autonomous Telco Networks](https://www.amdocs.com/insights/blog/how-ai-powered-digital-twins-are-driving-autonomous-telco-networks)**

<span class="digest-source">Amdocs</span>

<span class="lbl tldr">TLDR</span> Digital twins as a risk-free sandbox for telcos: what-if testing of network changes, predictive optimization, and the path toward autonomous network operations. A vendor framing of the digital-twin + AI management loop — twin as the safe space where the AI proposes and the network disposes.

<span class="lbl why">Why read it</span> A concrete vendor framing of the loop that sits at the core of your research direction.

<span class="digest-tags">#digital-twin · #autonomous-networks · #ai</span>
:::

::: {.digest-item}
**[Network Digital Twin: Concepts and Reference Architecture](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-irtf-nmrg-network-digital-twin-arch/09/)**

<span class="digest-source">IETF · IRTF</span>

<span class="lbl tldr">TLDR</span> An IRTF working draft defining the concepts and reference architecture for network digital twins — the vocabulary, the layering, and the boundary between the physical network and its digital counterpart, as the standards track sees it.

<span class="lbl why">Why read it</span> The standards-track definition of the exact concept under study. Worth reading for the vocabulary and layering it proposes, even if you disagree with parts of it.

<span class="digest-tags">#digital-twin · #standards</span>
:::
